categories.clear-accept: Clear accepts: the proof is faithful, followable, and honest
categories.no-evidence: No real evidence: assertion without artifacts, or artifacts that do not show the claimed behavior
categories.wrong-target: Wrong-target or unfaithful: adjacent symptom, silent environment deviation, or steps that skip the trigger
categories.unfollowable-comms: Unfollowable or comms failures: no environment record, steps a stranger cannot re-run, or a boilerplate over-promising comment
categories.disclosure: Disclosure walls: the repo's stated AI policy requires disclosure and the comment does not disclose

items.note: faithful offline repro of the missing Content-Type with a control run; env recorded; claim specific and modest
ran a prefix range instead of the issue's offset-from-end syntax; got a graceful arg-validation error (exit 1), narrated as the reported capacity-overflow crash (exit 101)
exact-steps repro on current version with a minus-replace control matching the owner's trigger note; version delta acknowledged; human-voiced comment satisfies the repo's AI-comment rule
pure me-too: no environment, no steps, no artifact; claim comment is a +1 with no intent
minimal env.yml repro with a json.tool parse failure as the artifact; conda's stated generative-AI policy is permissive-with-responsibility, no disclosure requirement

log excerpt looks right but there is no environment record at all (no OS, driver, or minikube version) and the steps omit the driver on a Windows-specific issue; a stranger cannot re-run or even place the attempt
language-priority repro with an English-first control; version delta stated; discloses AI assistance as p5.js's stated policy requires, which is what the conditional-policy pass looks like
modified the expression so $b is unbound, producing a compile error, not the issue's Invalid path expression behavior; two-machines certainty narrated over the wrong artifact
honest cannot-reproduce: real attempt at the argument-size reordering with marker-order artifacts, names what differed (uniform name lengths, 2 MiB ARG_MAX) and what a triggering setup likely needs
honest cannot-reproduce: exact layout and config, prompt artifact shown, names the environment differences (Linux+zsh vs macOS+fish) and the PWD-resolution hypothesis for why fish matters
terse but complete: env line, exact commands, failing run plus control character, expected vs actual as observations
both shapes reproduced on the current release with outputs shown; version delta stated; next step concrete
enthusiastic confirmation with zero artifacts: no measurements, no DWM observations, no steps; 'guaranteed reproducible' backed by nothing; self-assignment claim with no concrete intent

artifacts show only that zellij runs (version banner, session list, tabs visible); nothing shows a blank pane, a dump-screen result, or the log stall; 'expected' is even stated backwards from what was shown
confident root-cause diagnosis (debounce race) with no shown evidence: no repro transcript, no artifact, 'I verified this race condition' backed by nothing
tested pandas 1.5.3 against an issue confirmed on latest and main, without acknowledging the deviation; the shown ValueError is that old version's behavior, not evidence about the reported bug

polished report whose own artifact shows garbled escape-sequence output with the terminal still alive, presented as confirming a crash; also generalizes the bug to the Store release the maintainers could not reproduce on
reproduction lives entirely in a private monorepo with an unshared config; a stranger cannot re-run any step, and the trimmed trace differs from the issue's without comment
the repro report is fine; the claim comment is interchangeable assign-me boilerplate promising a guaranteed 2-day fix, which fails specificity and honest-intent

excellent repro on every proof check; ghostty's stated AI policy requires disclosing all AI usage and the comments do not disclose (course packages are treated as AI-assisted work); the one-item category the floor exists for
worksheet clear accept: terse but complete (env, 4 steps, stash-list artifact, expected vs actual); anchors 'looks rough, is fine'
worksheet clear reject: emphatic me-too with zero evidence and a cause asserted from vibes; every reasonable rubric holds it

worksheet trap (operator-swap package): long, confident, beautifully formatted, but the input uses a colon instead of '=', so the artifact is a graceful HCL syntax error, not the issue's panic; splits artifact-readers from formatting-graders

worksheet borderline: exact-command repro with the panic shown and a control run, but no environment record at all, on an issue where the build profile changes the failure mode; defensible both ways, master rejects on env-recorded
